newsitem.title: USA: Harcourt says Neiman to contribute $0.28/shr in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Harcourt says Neiman to contribute $0.28/shr in Q3.

text.p: Harcourt General Inc said Thursday Neiman Marcus Group will contribute $0.28 cents per share to its net earnings for the third quarter, compared with the $0.25 it contributed a year ago.
The company said its earnings include the operating results of Neiman Marcus, its 53 percent-owned subsidiary, with a lag of one quarter.
Neiman Marcus results will be consolidated with Harcourt General's third quarter ending July 31.

The company said it is entering the final half of the fiscal year with an optimistic outlook for "significant" revenue and earnings gains, and it expects to achieve its financial goals for the full year.
Harcourt General reported earnings per share in the second quarter of $0.04 compared with earnings per share of $0.14 for the same period a year ago.
Harcourt General is an operating company with core businesses in publishing and specialty retailing.
